purpose: Fingerprints and structural classification of official textbook files pulled from the portal. The PDFs themselves are deliberately NOT committed and NOT shipped: they are source material for preparing original lessons, not distributable assets.
method: tools/inspect-pdf.ps1 — counts /BaseFont, /ToUnicode, /Subtype /Image and DCTDecode markers in the raw PDF objects.

extraction.reason: Page-image scan: no embedded fonts and no ToUnicode maps, so there is no text to extract.
Page-image scan: no embedded fonts and no ToUnicode maps, so there is no text to extract.

conclusion: Every inspected official PDF is a page-image scan. Producing lesson text therefore requires OCR with Persian support. No OCR engine is available in the current build environment (no tesseract; the bundled Python and Node runtimes do not execute), so no lesson content has been authored. Authoring from memory instead of the controlling source would violate the project's source policy.
